note: G1, deposits, 16 px decor and 1x1 buildings (art plan batch G). 2026-10-30. One create_1_direction_object job: size 16, view top-down, palette = the 46 Apollo hexes, palette_name Apollo, name g1_ground, 64 candidates, 10 generations. PixelLab review object 24e3ecff-58f0-4530-95b7-a29483b1e399 (job a76bca04-715b-4405-b7d0-8b08f8da878e). All 64 frames are kept untouched in art/raw/g1/candidates/frame_<i>.png (slot map in _slots). Chosen frames were promoted with select_object_frames (tag g1_ground); each src below is that object's image, byte-identical to its frame, or a free pixelart_workbench fix of it in art/raw/g1/fixed/ (_fix). Every frame came back 100% Apollo with no partial alpha, opaque art inside 14x14 with a 1 px margin. The anchored G2 re-roll is g_ground_2.json; sprites it replaced are not listed here (no overrides). Deposit names follow the game (d_<ore item id>_<1-3>: iron_ore, copper_ore, chorus_crystal; STYLE.md's manifest shortens them). Decor uses the STYLE.md manifest names (x_l<layer>_<name>), which are the game's own: each layer's decor list in src/data/layers.ts (16 x 16 here; m1_machines has the 32 x 32 props). _light is [x, y, w, h] in final 16 x 16 sprite pixels (art plan issue 11; not read by art:build yet). Judged on gmock scenes: each ore drawn as a patch on every floor it appears on, over the renderer's ore bed (TERRAIN_PAL bed, dithered edge) with the game's variant hash and +-2 px offsets; decor on its layer floor; 1x1 buildings beside M1 machines and belts, lit and lamp-dark.
_prompt: description: small pixel art game sprite for a top-down factory game, lit from upper left, crisp selective dark outline, no ground shadow, transparent background. item_descriptions: the art plan's per-sprite lines (art.md, batch G) with 'seen from directly above' for deposits, 'high top-down 3/4 view' for buildings, deposit veins 'from corner to corner', copper rock 'dark brown' (umber would vanish on the L1 floor), thrumstone 'pale grey-green', plus b_chute: 'tiny building in high top-down 3/4 view: company sales chute, square steel hopper with a flat company-yellow rim, dark open funnel mouth on top, white stencil mark and a coin slot'.
_slots: 0-26 deposits (iron, copper, stone, coal, sapstone, glowcap, chorus, emberite, thrumstone; layouts 1-3 each: diagonal vein, one big lump plus chips, four near the corners); 27-41 decor (l0 bush, grass, pebbles, survey_flag; l1 stalagmite, rubble; l2 mushroom_small, spore_pod, moss_clump; l3 crystal_small, geode; l4 vent, ember_rock; l5 glass_shard, relic); 42-48 b_lamp, b_crate, b_shield_wall, b_foundation, b_unloader, b_sequencer, b_chute; 49-54 second rolls of lamp, crate, shield_wall, unloader, sequencer, chute; 55-60 a fourth layout ('scattered out to all four edges') for coal, chorus, glowcap, thrumstone, emberite, sapstone; 61-63 second rolls of x_l0_bush, x_l1_stalagmite, x_l3_geode.

_rejected.d_iron_ore: 0: the 'diagonal vein from corner to corner' came back as a % sign (two lumps split by a long rust line) that repeats as a pattern of % signs across a patch
_rejected.d_coal: 9, 10, 11, 55 as drawn: black lumps whose facets stop at #394a50/#577277, 0-2 px at 3:1 on the floors and 0-11 on the ore beds (STYLE: coal needs #819796 facets), so they vanish on the L4/L5 beds. Frame 9 is used with its facets lifted (d_coal_3); the rest lost to G2
_rejected.d_glowcap: 16: five 3 px dots, 12x11, reads as specks
_rejected.d_emberite: 21: the % sign again (lumps split by a red X)
_rejected.d_thrumstone: 24: one long capsule, reads as a pill; 26: four plain pebbles, lost to G2 frame 31
_rejected.d_sapstone: 12: four amber rings around blue stones read as buttons
_rejected.x_l0_bush: 61: denser, berry dots; 27 has the clearer twiggy base
_rejected.x_l0_grass: 28: sand-coloured tuft, invisible on the ochre floor (lost to G2 48)
_rejected.x_l3_crystal_small: 36: a 10x10 stub (lost to G2 46, a dull cluster matching x_l3_crystal_large)
_rejected.x_l3_geode: 63: two linked rings, reads as a chain
_rejected.x_l4_vent: 38: a dark mound, no opening (lost to G2 39)
_rejected.x_l5_relic: 41: a plain speckled slab with no glyph; on the L5 slab floor it reads as a loose floor tile (lost to G2 37)
_rejected.b_crate: 43: blue-tinted box with a diagonal strap; 50: grey box, busy front (both lost to G2 49)
_rejected.b_shield_wall: 51: grey glass block with a cyan grid, reads as ice
_rejected.b_unloader: 46: busy blue front; 52: red and orange clutter (lost to G2 57)
_rejected.b_sequencer: 47: flat grid front, tiny lights; 53: noisy, no lights (lost to G2 56)
_rejected.b_chute: 48: steel hopper with a yellow rim, reads like the crate and unloader at 1x; 54: brown clutter (lost to G2 59)
_rejected.b_foundation: 45 is used, but PixelLab leaves a 1 px margin at size 16, so the rim was extended (see _fix)
